To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
ER fluids can be used for building soft robots capable of locomotion, and that ER fluids can simplify the design of soft robots by simplifying the hydraulic circuits.

(1) the use of ER fluid valves allows to simplify the hydraulic circuit of fluidic based robotic systems, (2) ER valves are capable to control the flexibility of soft robot body and, (3) ER fluidic based soft robotic systems are capable of locomotion.

we developed a composite ER valve capable of controlling the flexibility of a soft robot body and we demonstrated its potential application in the design of a simple crawling robot (Wormobot), a locomotion mechanism and a tendon driven continuum robotic arm.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and characterization of innovative soft robots based on ER fluid valves.
the development of soft robots based on ER fluids and their potential applications.
the development of soft robots based on ER fluids, and with their potential applications to the design of soft robotic devices.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

ER fluids are a very promising technology that could be used to develop soft robots with a reduced number of components and a simple hydraulic circuits, with a potential to simplify the control system.
the use of ER valves in soft robots can simplify design of the hydraulic circuitry and can lead to more efficient soft robots.
the proposed design and the preliminary experiments demonstrate the potentiality of ER fluids for the development of innovative and efficient soft robots.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ER fluids can be exploited as a smart material to build soft components, simplifying fluidic circuits and enabling new soft robots designs.
ER fluids are promising materials to build simple and smart components for fluidic soft robots.
ER valves represent an effective solution to simplify design of fluid-driven soft robots, while allowing for a high degree of adaptability and re-configurability.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ER fluids can simplify design of fluid-based soft robots by reducing their hydraulic complexity.
ER valves can be easily implemented in fluidic soft robots and can simplify their design.
ER valves are a simple, yet powerful, building block to simplify design of fluid based soft robots.
